Name: Lost Book Menu
Author: BussinBungus
Description:
[b][size=4]Overview[/size][/b]
[size=3]This mod adds a menu allowing you to read any lost books you've found without having to search the library shelves for the book you want. The menu can be opened either by clicking on the newly added book by Gunther in the museum, or via a configurable key (not set by default).[/size]

[size=3]By itself, this mod uses the vanilla Lost Book texture for covers. However, I highly recommend that you also get [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15393]Random Lost Library Book Covers[/url][size=3] by Airyn which allows this mod to use his covers![/size]

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]First, look at the images from version 1.1.0+ above to decide which style you want, 'Original' or 'Smaller.' Note that the images were taken at 2560x1440 resolution, and your actual menus WILL BE BIGGER if your resolution is smaller. As of 2.0.0, both styles are included in the same mod download and can be switched between in the mod's config.[/size]
[*][size=3]If installing manually, extract the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]If installing via mod manager, download using your manager and install normally.[/size]
[*][size=3]To uninstall, simply delete the mod from your mods folder.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]
[size=3]After running the game with the mod installed, you can edit the mod's config with GMCM or directly in the config.json that is generated.[/size]

[b][size=4]Known Issues[/size][/b]
[size=3]No known issues currently! By using the 'Smaller' version and tweaking config settings as needed, the menu should work with any resolutions. The mod also supports multiplayer (including split-screen) and controllers. If you find any issues, please report them![/size]
